title: Anyone know where I can find some modern day ship character sets?

posts.author: MoonWolfV
posts.body:
My current project is set in modern times and trying to find modern ships in the rpgmaker MV and MZ sets seems to be pretty much non-existent.
I do have a couple what I've made but my digital drawing skills aren't the best. Does anyone know of an image for what would pass a freighter / cargo ship, and one which is a military ship?
Cheers
PS. This project is being made in Rpg Maker MZ.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Do we talk about small charsets for the worldmap?
Which makers do you own (since that determines what you can legally use)?

posts.author: MoonWolfV
posts.body:
Yes, small character sets for the world map would do fine.
To be honest, I actually hadn't considered this. My characters are just their normal heights, as big as the towns themselves. - Doesn't seem very realistic.
To answer the question about the Rpg Maker programs: I have XP, MV, and MZ. (I have 2000 and 2003 too but they hardly count)
Note: It might actually be best to not proceed with this for the time being, you've given me inspiration about creating small character sets for the world map. Making ships and vehicles etc might actually be easier on a smaller scale. I just don't want somebody spending their time making resources, when in the meantime I've made one which I've decided I'm quite happy with. - I'll post again if I'm looking for vehicle graphics at a later date.
